scope: Add a collection-scoped experimental synonym catalog and lookup command that retains every competing record or field selector.

limitations: This study uses authored catalog expressions and questions. No blind semantic or domain validation is claimed.
The index is an opt-in selector suggestion tool. The strict default pipeline is unchanged.
